They were led by sixth-year head coach [[Chris Collins (basketball)|Chris Collins]] as members of the [[Big Ten Conference]]. They played their home games at the newly renovated [[Welsh-Ryan Arena]] in [[Evanston, Illinois]]. The Wildcats finished the season 13–19, 4–16 in [[2018–19 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season|Big Ten play]] to finish in last place.
